report: Cross-verse table: every multi-treatment bucket is context the source licenses — suffix pronouns vary by case (my/thee/I), בְּ by what the ASV wrote (in/into/while/when/by, unrepresented where the object is promoted to a bare direct object), חַיִּים life vs live, אֶרֶץ construct vs absolute. No split found.

One within-verse correction, PSA.63.5: the *with* of *as with marrow and fatness* was placed on כְּמוֹ as a two-word rendering; it is the elided comparative member's predicate preposition (*satisfied with*), and rule 25's own example (*search for her as for hid treasures*: comparative כְּ takes only *as*, the *for* goes to the verb) puts it on תִּשְׂבַּע. Subtraction agrees: dropping *with* leaves the comparison stated and only the verb's reach to its complement gone. Patched; edges otherwise unchanged.

Judgment calls left as aligned, each with its competitor named in the unit note: PSA.63.1 בְּלִי → *where no ... is* (privative phrase recast as a relative clause, by analogy to rule 41's articleless attributive); PSA.63.8 יְמִינֶךָ → *right hand* headed on *hand* (rule 31's class-noun tie-break, as JOB.4.17 *mortal man* heads on *man*); PSA.63.9 הֵמָּה → *those that* (rule 17's pronoun-as-relative recasting); PSA.63.11 כָּל → *Every one* with *that* on the article.

BSB disagreements (63.7 directive he, 63.7 לִּי, 63.8 בִּי) are all documented convention differences — rule 32 leaves a directive he unrepresented where the ASV writes nothing for it, and rule 40 silences a preposition whose object is recast as a possessive or a bare direct object. None is an error.

The two notes the validator saw repeating (rule 29 supplied the, rule 28 attributive rectum) restate contract rules and need no convention. Nothing here generalises beyond what rules 25, 31, 40 and 41 already say; no promotions or amendments.
